title: Transformation: Exclamatory ↔ Assertive & Assertive → Imperative
lede: একাডেমির হ্যান্ডনোট অনুযায়ী তিন পর্ব — Exclamatory→Assertive (৫ নিয়ম), Assertive→Exclamatory (৪ নিয়ম), Assertive→Imperative (৬ নিয়ম), প্রতিটি উদাহরণ ও বাংলা অর্থসহ।

objectives.t: Turn any exclamatory sentence into assertive
objectives.d: very / great / It is a matter of… / I wish
Assertive → What a…! How…! Hurrah! Alas!

objectives.t: Make imperatives from should / must sentences
objectives.d: You should → base verb; He should → Let him

rules.name: ‘What’ বা ‘How’ যুক্ত বাক্য
rules.bn: Subject + Verb + a/an (যদি থাকে) + **very/great** + Adjective/Noun। মনে রাখো — **Adjective-এর পূর্বে very** আর **Noun-এর পূর্বে great** বসে।
rules.ex: What a beautiful bird it is! → It is a ==very== beautiful bird. · What a fool I am! → I am a ==great== fool.

rules.name: Interjection যুক্ত বাক্য (Hurrah, Alas, Bravo, Fie)
rules.bn: আনন্দ বোঝালে **It is a matter of joy that**, দুঃখ বোঝালে **It is a matter of sorrow that**, আর লজ্জা বোঝালে **It is a matter of shame that** বসে + বাকি অংশ।
rules.formula: Hurrah → joy · Alas → sorrow · Fie → shame
rules.ex: Hurrah! We have won the game. → ==It is a matter of joy that== we have won the game.

rules.name: ‘If’, ‘Had’, ‘O that’, ‘Would that’ যুক্ত বাক্য
rules.bn: অপূর্ণ ইচ্ছা বোঝাতে বাক্যের শুরুতে **Subject + wish** বসে।
rules.formula: If / Had / O that / Would that … ! → I wish …
rules.ex: If I were a king! → ==I wish== I were a king. · Had I the wings of a dove! → ==I wish== I had the wings of a dove.

rules.name: Subject ও Verb বিহীন Exclamatory বাক্য
rules.bn: বাক্যে subject ও verb না থাকলে Assertive করার সময় শুরুতে **It is** ধরে নিতে হয়।
rules.formula: What a …! → It is a great …
rules.ex: What a pity! → ==It is a great pity==. · What an idea! → ==It is a great idea==.

rules.name: ‘Oh, for’ যুক্ত বাক্য (তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা)
rules.bn: ‘Oh, for’-এর পরিবর্তে **Subject + strongly desire / wish for** বসে।
rules.formula: Oh, for + noun ! → Subject + strongly desire for + noun
rules.ex: Oh, for a glass of water! → I ==strongly desire for== a glass of water.

rules.name: ‘Very’ বা ‘Great’ যুক্ত বাক্য
rules.bn: বাক্যে **a/an থাকলে What a/an** দিয়ে শুরু হয়, আর **a/an না থাকলে How** দিয়ে শুরু হয় + Adjective + Subject + Verb + **!**
rules.formula: a/an আছে → What a/an … ! · a/an নেই → How … !
rules.ex: The scenery is very charming. → ==How== charming the scenery is! · He is a very brilliant student. → ==What a== brilliant student he is!

rules.name: ‘I wish’ যুক্ত বাক্য
rules.bn: **I wish** উঠে গিয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে **If / Had / O that / Would that** বসে এবং শেষে **!** বসে।
rules.formula: I wish + clause → If / Had / O that / Would that + clause !
rules.ex: I wish I had a car. → ==If== I had a car! · I wish I could fly in the sky. → ==Would that== I could fly in the sky!

rules.name: Joy, Sorrow বা Shame বোঝালে
rules.bn: **‘It is a matter of…’** উঠে গিয়ে **Hurrah / Alas / Fie** বসে।
rules.formula: matter of joy → Hurrah! · sorrow → Alas! · shame → Fie!
rules.ex: It is a matter of joy that I got GPA-5. → ==Hurrah!== I got GPA-5. · It is a matter of sorrow that he is dead. → ==Alas!== he is dead.

rules.name: ‘We rejoice that’ / ‘We regret that’
rules.formula: We rejoice that → Hurrah! · We regret that → Alas!
rules.ex: We rejoice that we are victorious. → ==Hurrah!== we are victorious. · We regret that she failed. → ==Alas!== she failed.

rules.name: Second Person — Affirmative (হ্যাঁ-বোধক)
rules.bn: বাক্যের Subject (**You**) এবং Auxiliary Verb (**should, must**) বাদ যায়। সরাসরি মূল Verb-এর **Base form** দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হয়।
rules.ex: You should do the work. → ==Do the work==. · You must speak the truth. → ==Speak the truth==.

rules.name: Second Person — Negative (না-বোধক)
rules.bn: **You should not**-এর পরিবর্তে **Do not (Don't)** এবং **You must never**-এর পরিবর্তে **Never** বসে + মূল Verb।
rules.formula: You should not → Do not / Don't · You must never → Never
rules.ex: You should not waste your time. → ==Do not== waste your time. · You must never tell a lie. → ==Never== tell a lie.

rules.name: ‘Always’ যুক্ত বাক্য
rules.bn: বাক্যে **always** থাকলে Imperative করার সময় সরাসরি **Always** দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হয়।
rules.formula: You should always + V1 → Always + V1
rules.ex: You should always speak the truth. → ==Always== speak the truth. · You must always remember this. → ==Always== remember this.

rules.name: First & Third Person (I, He, She, We, They)
rules.bn: বাক্যের শুরুতে **Let** বসে + Subject-এর **Objective form** (me, him, her, us, them) + **Base Verb**।
rules.ex: He plays football. → ==Let him play== football. · We should go out for a walk. → ==Let us go== out for a walk.

rules.name: Let-এর সঙ্গে ‘not’ কোথায় বসবে
rules.bn: Subject যদি **Noun** হয় (Rahim, Mina), তবে **‘not’ Noun-এর আগে** বসে। কিন্তু **Pronoun** (him, me, her) হলে **‘not’ Pronoun-এর পরে** বসে।
rules.formula: Noun → Let not + Noun + V1  |  Pronoun → Let + pronoun + not + V1
rules.ex: Mina does not sing. → ==Let not Mina== sing. · She does not sing. → ==Let her not== sing.

rules.name: Request ও Nobody / None / No one
rules.bn: **‘You are requested to’** উঠে গিয়ে **Please** বা **Kindly** বসে। আর Subject **Nobody / None / No one** হলে **Let not** দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয় (অথবা Let + anyone/anybody + not)।
rules.formula: You are requested to → Please / Kindly · Nobody/None/No one → Let none / Let nobody
rules.ex: You are requested to help me. → ==Please== help me. · Nobody should break the rules. → ==Let nobody== break the rules. · None will go there. → ==Let none== go there.

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — Exclamatory → Assertive
drills.intro: প্রথমে দেখো adjective না noun — তারপর very না great।

items.q: What a beautiful bird it is!
items.ans: It is a very beautiful bird.

items.q: How sweetly the girl sings!
items.why: Adverb sweetly → very; a/an নেই তাই How। (নিয়ম ০১)

items.q: What a fool I am!
Hurrah! We have won the game.
items.ans: It is a matter of joy that we have won the game.

items.q: Alas! I am undone.
items.ans: It is a matter of sorrow that I am undone.

items.q: Fie! You are a liar.
items.ans: It is a matter of shame that you are a liar.

items.q: If I were a king!
items.ans: I wish I were a king.

items.q: Had I the wings of a dove!
items.ans: I wish I had the wings of a dove.

items.q: What a pity!
items.why: Subject ও verb নেই → It is ধরে নিতে হবে। (নিয়ম ০৪)

items.q: What an idea!
Oh, for a glass of water!
items.ans: I strongly desire for a glass of water.

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — Assertive → Exclamatory
drills.intro: a/an আছে কি নেই — এটাই What আর How-এর পার্থক্য।

items.q: The scenery is very charming.
He is a very brilliant student.
items.ans: What a brilliant student he is!

items.q: I wish I had a car.
I wish I could fly in the sky.
items.ans: Would that I could fly in the sky!

items.q: It is a matter of joy that I got GPA-5.
It is a matter of sorrow that he is dead.
We rejoice that we are victorious.
We regret that she failed.

drills.title: Practice Set 3 — Assertive → Imperative
drills.intro: Subject কে — You হলে verb দিয়ে শুরু, অন্য কেউ হলে Let।

items.q: You should do the work.
items.why: You ও should বাদ, base verb দিয়ে শুরু। (নিয়ম ১০)

items.q: You must speak the truth.
You should not waste your time.
You must never tell a lie.
You should always speak the truth.
You must always remember this.
He plays football.
items.why: Third person → Let + him + base verb। (নিয়ম ১৩)

items.q: We should go out for a walk.
items.ans: Let us go out for a walk.

items.q: Mina does not sing.
She does not sing.
You are requested to help me.
Nobody should break the rules.
None will go there.

items.q: What a beautiful bird it is! (Assertive)
items.ans: It is a very beautiful bird.

items.why: Noun-এর আগে **great** — এখানেই সবচেয়ে বেশি ভুল হয়। (নিয়ম ০১)

items.q: Alas! I am undone. (Assertive)
items.ans: It is a matter of sorrow that I am undone.

items.q: The scenery is very charming. (Exclamatory)
I wish I were a king. (Exclamatory)
items.why: I wish → If / Had / Would that। (নিয়ম ০৭)

items.q: You should not waste your time. (Imperative)
We should go out for a walk. (Imperative)
items.ans: Let us go out for a walk.

You are requested to help me. (Imperative)

extras.title: Exclamatory ↔ Assertive at a glance — দুই দিকেই একই জোড়া

rows: What a beautiful bird it is!
It is a very beautiful bird.
Hurrah! We have won the game.
It is a matter of joy that we have won the game.
আনন্দের বিষয় যে আমরা খেলায় জিতেছি।
It is a matter of sorrow that I am undone.
দুঃখের বিষয় যে আমার সর্বনাশ হয়েছে।
It is a matter of shame that you are a liar.
লজ্জার বিষয় যে তুমি একজন মিথ্যুক।
I wish I were a king.
আমার ইচ্ছা হয় আমি যদি রাজা হতাম।
Had I the wings of a dove!
I wish I had the wings of a dove.
আমার ইচ্ছা হয় আমার যদি ঘুঘুর ডানা থাকত।
Oh, for a glass of water!
I strongly desire for a glass of water.
আমার এক গ্লাস পানির জন্য তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা হচ্ছে।
You should not waste your time.
You must never tell a lie.
You should always speak the truth.
We should go out for a walk.
Let us go out for a walk.
You are requested to help me.

tips.d: ==Adjective/Adverb== এর আগে **very**, আর ==Noun== এর আগে **great**। ‘What a fool I am!’ → a ==great== fool, very নয়।
বাক্যে ==a/an থাকলে What a/an==, না থাকলে ==How==। এই একটাই প্রশ্ন করলেই উত্তর বেরিয়ে আসে।
Noun হলে ==Let not Mina sing==, pronoun হলে ==Let her not sing== — উল্টো লিখলে ভুল।
Exclamatory করলে শেষে ==!== আর Assertive করলে ==.== — চিহ্ন ভুল হলে নম্বর কাটে।

recap: Interjection: Hurrah→joy, Alas→sorrow, Fie→shame + ‘It is a matter of … that’।
If/Had/O that/Would that → I wish; Subject-verb না থাকলে ‘It is’ ধরে নাও।
Assertive→Exclamatory: a/an আছে → What a…!, নেই → How…!; I wish → If/Would that।
Assertive→Imperative: You+should/must বাদ → base verb; না-বোধক → Do not/Never।
I/He/We/They → Let + objective form; noun হলে ‘Let not + noun’, pronoun হলে ‘Let + pronoun + not’।
homework: Exclamatory ↔ Assertive টেবিলের ১০টি জোড়া মুখস্থ না করে নিজে লিখে আনবে।
Practice Set 3-এর ১৩টি বাক্য খাতায় সমাধান করবে।
very ও great দিয়ে নিজে ৫টি করে বাক্য বানাবে।
